info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fraud Model Management API
info.description: The Fraud Model Management API facilitates the dynamic updating and optimization of fraud detection models within the banking sector. This endpoint allows authorized users to modify existing fraud model parameters, enhancing the efficacy of fraud detection mechanisms. Typical consumers of this API include data scientists, fraud analysts, and application developers working to ensure the robustness of fraud prevention strategies. By leveraging this API, organizations can swiftly adapt to evolving fraud patterns, ensuring a secure banking environment.
